text:
Which statement about sound waves is correct?
A
They are able to travel through a vacuum.
B
They are able to travel through solids.
C
They are transverse waves.
D
They travel at the same speed in all substances.

options.label: A
options.text: They are able to travel through a vacuum.

options.label: B
options.text: They are able to travel through solids.

options.label: D
options.text: They travel at the same speed in all substances.
